definitions.explanation: A male sovereign or ruler. Used for kings in history, fairy tales, and foreign countries.
Used as a suffix or title to indicate the supreme or dominant figure in a field. Common in games, sports, and informal rankings.

examples.japanese: {王|おう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|おさ}めた→治める：02462_osameru⟧。
むかしむかし、⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{王|おう}がいました。
examples.english: Once upon a time, there was a king in a certain land.

examples.japanese: ルイ{十四世|じゅうよんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{太陽王|たいようおう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{王|おう}だった。
examples.english: Louis XIV was a great king called the 'Sun King.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{本塁打|ほんるいだ}→本塁打：24569_honruida⟧{王|おう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: He won the home run crown.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王|おう}だ。
examples.english: That shop is the king of ramen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{王|おう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られたら→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧だ。
examples.english: In shogi, you lose if your king is captured.

notes:
Means 'king' both literally and figuratively. As a suffix, it designates the top figure in a domain.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧ — king (polite/fairy-tale form)
- ⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧ — prince
- ⟦{王女|おうじょ}→王女：04108_oujo⟧ — princess
- ⟦{王国|おうこく}→王国：15857_oukoku⟧ — kingdom
- ⟦{王座|おうざ}→王座：21328_ouza⟧ — throne
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧ — queen
- ⟦{国王|こくおう}→国王：04152_kokuou⟧ — king (of a country)
- ⟦{王冠|おうかん}→王冠：15932_oukan⟧ — crown

AS A SUFFIX (~{王|おう}):
- {本塁打王|ほんるいだおう} — home run king/champion
- ⟦{打点王|だてんおう}→打点王：29935_datenou⟧ — RBI champion
- {海賊王|かいぞくおう} — pirate king
- ⟦{魔王|まおう}→魔王：14768_maou⟧ — demon king

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皇帝|こうてい}→皇帝：15856_koutei⟧ — emperor (higher rank than king)
- ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧ — Emperor of Japan (specific title)
- ⟦{君主|くんしゅ}→君主：15298_kunshu⟧ — monarch, sovereign (formal/generic)
